skin_type.description: Classifies your skin into oily, dry, combination, or normal based on sebum distribution, shine patterns, pore visibility, and hydration cues across the 5 imaging modes.
skin_type.client_description: Your skin looks mostly balanced but with a mild tendency toward combination behavior, especially through the central face.
skin_type.score_explanation: There is mild oil activity through the T-zone with relatively balanced cheeks, while hydration appears generally adequate. Pores and congestion are more noticeable in the center of the face, which supports a combination pattern rather than fully oily or dry skin.
possible_causes: Natural variation in oil production between the T-zone and cheeks
Mild follicular congestion in the central face
skin_type.target_interpretation_rule: Stable categorical classification; target is to maintain or move only when imaging and feature-packet evidence clearly support a different category.

barrier_health_sensitivity.description: Evaluates redness, flaking, barrier uniformity, hydration stress, and reactivity using the 5-mode system plus the feature packet.
barrier_health_sensitivity.client_description: Your skin barrier looks fairly stable overall, with only mild signs of sensitivity.
barrier_health_sensitivity.score_explanation: Your skin does not show much flaking or obvious surface damage, which is a good sign. There is some mild redness and slight hydration stress, so the barrier looks a little reactive rather than fully compromised.
barrier_health_sensitivity.target_interpretation_rule: Lower score is better; target is progressive downward movement toward 1 while preserving clinical realism and avoiding overcalling improvement.

visual_acne_grading.description: Assesses active acne burden, comedones, inflammatory lesions and clustering using the new 5-mode system plus the feature packet.
visual_acne_grading.client_description: You have a mild but visible amount of acne activity, with a mix of clogged pores and a few inflamed spots.
visual_acne_grading.score_explanation: Breakouts are present across the forehead, cheeks, and chin, but they are not dense or deeply cystic. The pattern looks like mild active acne with some ongoing congestion and leftover post-acne marking.
visual_acne_grading.target_interpretation_rule: Lower score is better; target is progressive downward movement toward 1 while preserving clinical realism and avoiding overcalling improvement.

skin_sebum_content.description: Assesses visible oiliness, shine pattern, follicular congestion, porphyrin-like support, and sebum variability using the 5-mode system plus the feature packet.
skin_sebum_content.client_description: Your skin does not look very oily overall, but there is some mild sebum activity and congestion in the central face.
skin_sebum_content.score_explanation: Visible shine is fairly limited, which keeps the overall oil level from looking high. At the same time, the pores and follicular areas suggest some mild oil-related congestion rather than a fully dry pattern.
possible_causes: Mild sebaceous activity in the T-zone
skin_sebum_content.target_interpretation_rule: Middle-to-ideal range is best; target is movement toward the clinically appropriate balance zone rather than uniformly lower or higher values.

vascularity_redness_profiling.description: Assesses visible redness, vascular prominence, diffuse erythema and inflammatory hotspots using red-first evidence plus the feature packet.
vascularity_redness_profiling.client_description: Your skin shows mild redness overall, with a slightly reactive look rather than strong ongoing inflammation.
vascularity_redness_profiling.score_explanation: Redness is visible but not intense, and it appears spread lightly rather than concentrated in severe patches. There are some mild reactive and acne-linked red areas, but not strong vessel prominence or severe flushing.
vascularity_redness_profiling.target_interpretation_rule: Lower score is better; target is progressive downward movement toward 1 while preserving clinical realism and avoiding overcalling improvement.

skin_hydration_score.description: Measures plumpness, reflectance, micro-lines, dryness fluorescence and hydration support using the 5-mode system plus the feature packet.
skin_hydration_score.client_description: Your skin looks reasonably hydrated, though not at its most plump or dewy level.
skin_hydration_score.score_explanation: The skin surface appears fairly even without strong flaking, and there are only mild dehydration lines. Hydration looks adequate overall, but there is still room for more bounce and softness, especially in the lower face and cheek areas.
possible_causes: Everyday water loss from the skin surface
Slight imbalance between hydration and surface smoothness
skin_hydration_score.target_interpretation_rule: Higher score is better; target is progressive upward movement toward 100 while preserving clinical realism and avoiding overstating short-term gains.

skin_luminosity_glow_index.description: Assesses brightness, glow, reflectance uniformity and dullness using the 5-mode system plus the feature packet.
skin_luminosity_glow_index.client_description: Your skin has a moderate natural glow, but it is not especially radiant right now.
skin_luminosity_glow_index.score_explanation: Your complexion has some visible brightness and fairly even light reflection, but mild uneven tone and texture reduce the overall glow. It looks healthy rather than dull, though not especially luminous.
possible_causes: Pigmentation and texture softening the overall glow
skin_luminosity_glow_index.target_interpretation_rule: Higher score is better; target is progressive upward movement toward 100 while preserving clinical realism and avoiding overstating short-term gains.

superficial_pigmentation_score.description: Assesses visible pigment burden, intensity, contrast, distribution and depth support using the 5-mode system plus the feature packet.
superficial_pigmentation_score.client_description: There is mild to moderate visible pigmentation, mainly as scattered uneven tone and post-breakout marks.
superficial_pigmentation_score.score_explanation: Pigment is most noticeable across the forehead and cheeks, where there are scattered darker marks and a mottled tone. The spots are visible in normal lighting but are not extremely dense or very dark overall.
superficial_pigmentation_score.target_interpretation_rule: Lower score is better; target is progressive downward movement toward 1 while preserving clinical realism and avoiding overcalling improvement.

periorbital_health.description: Assesses under-eye pigment, vascularity, hollowness, puffiness and fine-line burden using the 5-mode system plus the feature packet.
periorbital_health.client_description: The eye area shows mild concerns, mainly from darkness and some puffiness.
periorbital_health.score_explanation: There is visible under-eye darkness with a little puffiness, while hollowness and fine lines remain fairly mild. The overall eye-area concern looks noticeable but not advanced.
possible_causes: Pigment and vascular darkness under the eyes
periorbital_health.target_interpretation_rule: Lower score is better; target is progressive downward movement toward 1 while preserving clinical realism and avoiding overcalling improvement.

lip_pigmentation.description: Assesses visible lip darkening, intrinsic melanin support and vascular congestion using the 5-mode system plus the feature packet.
lip_pigmentation.client_description: Your lips show mild natural pigmentation, with a fairly even overall appearance.
lip_pigmentation.score_explanation: There is some mild natural lip darkening, more from inherent pigment than strong redness or irritation. The color looks relatively even and not heavily pronounced.
possible_causes: Natural melanin distribution in the lips
Mild background lip dryness or tone variation
lip_pigmentation.target_interpretation_rule: Lower score is better; target is progressive downward movement toward 1 while preserving clinical realism and avoiding overcalling improvement.

texture_open_pores_scoring.description: Assesses pore size, distribution, blackhead/congestion burden, and surface irregularity using the 5-mode system plus the feature packet.
texture_open_pores_scoring.client_description: Your pores and skin texture are mildly to moderately visible, especially around the nose and inner cheeks.
texture_open_pores_scoring.score_explanation: Pores are clearly visible in the central face and cheeks, with some mild roughness and congestion. The texture does not look severe, but it is noticeable enough to soften the smoothness of the skin.
possible_causes: Oil-related congestion and uneven surface texture
texture_open_pores_scoring.target_interpretation_rule: Lower score is better; target is progressive downward movement toward 1 while preserving clinical realism and avoiding overcalling improvement.

superficial_wrinkles_scoring.description: Measures fine lines, etched lines, and early wrinkle patterns using the 5-mode system plus the feature packet.
superficial_wrinkles_scoring.client_description: Only minimal surface wrinkling is visible at this time.
superficial_wrinkles_scoring.score_explanation: Fine lines are light overall and appear more subtle than fixed or etched. Most of the line pattern looks early and mild rather than strongly age-related.
possible_causes: Mild natural skin folding around expressive areas
superficial_wrinkles_scoring.target_interpretation_rule: Lower score is better; target is progressive downward movement toward 1 while preserving clinical realism and avoiding overcalling improvement.

jawline_sagging_score.description: Assesses jawline definition, tissue descent, and contour smoothness using the 5-mode system plus the feature packet.
jawline_sagging_score.client_description: Your jawline looks fairly well defined, with only minimal early softness.
jawline_sagging_score.score_explanation: The lower face contour remains mostly smooth and stable, without marked jowling or heavy tissue descent. Any softness present looks early and mild rather than advanced.
jawline_sagging_score.target_interpretation_rule: Lower score is better; target is progressive downward movement toward 1 while preserving clinical realism and avoiding overcalling improvement.

skin_firmness_elasticity_index.description: Assesses subtle laxity, collagen reflectance support, and firmness behavior using the 5-mode system plus the feature packet.
skin_firmness_elasticity_index.client_description: Your skin firmness looks generally good, with only mild early loss of elasticity.
skin_firmness_elasticity_index.score_explanation: The skin still appears to hold its shape fairly well, but there are some mild early signs of reduced firmness. This looks more like subtle softening than advanced laxity.
skin_firmness_elasticity_index.target_interpretation_rule: Lower score is better; target is progressive downward movement toward 1 while preserving clinical realism and avoiding overcalling improvement.

textural_radiance_index.description: Assesses surface clarity, smooth scatter, and keratin-related radiance loss using the 5-mode system plus the feature packet.
textural_radiance_index.client_description: Your skin texture looks moderately refined, but there is some surface haze that reduces a polished finish.
textural_radiance_index.score_explanation: The skin surface looks reasonably smooth overall, but pores, mild congestion, and slight unevenness reduce a crisp, polished appearance. This gives the skin a moderate loss of textural radiance rather than a very glassy finish.
possible_causes: Visible pores and mild surface irregularity
textural_radiance_index.target_interpretation_rule: Lower score is better; target is progressive downward movement toward 1 while preserving clinical realism and avoiding overcalling improvement.

treatments.title: Carbon Clarity Reset
preparations_checklist_for_therapist: Confirm whether salicylic acid or glycolic acid was used yesterday; defer Carbon laser if yes until clinician clears.
Map active lesion footprints versus extractable non-inflamed comedones; do not plan extraction on papules/pustules.
Preload Hydrafacial serums: SA2 for T-zone congestion and AS1 for cheeks.
Prepare Carbon Lotion and confirm the approved local conservative Carbon Facial laser preset; if preset is not available in file, clinician must load the approved protocol before treatment.
Preload approved post-extraction high-frequency acne-support preset and red LED recovery mode; clinician completes settings if protocol file is absent.
Left cheek is the hotter side; reduce local intensity there and extend soothing/cooling on that side.

lip_pigmentation_rule.reason: Client lip pigmentation display score is 70; the add-on triggers only below 70.

steps.settings_note: Use cleanser only; no device preset.
steps.how_to_do: Cleanse face and neck with derma decode Gentle Hydrating Cleanser Face Wash, remove sunscreen and surface oil fully, keep under-eye and lip pressure light, and pat dry before machine work.
steps.script: Gentle cleanse to remove oil, sunscreen and surface debris.
additional_products: derma decode Gentle Hydrating Cleanser Face Wash

steps.settings_note: Approved suction preset not supplied; use approved clinic Hydrafacial setting, SA2 through T-zone and AS1 on cheeks.
steps.duration_rationale: Four minutes to zone central congestion separately from the cheeks.
steps.how_to_do: Perform hydradermabrasion with SA2 over forehead, nose and chin for follicular congestion, then lighter AS1 passes over both cheeks; reduce suction and one pass on the hotter left cheek; avoid direct suction on active papules/pustules and under-eye skin.
steps.script: Serum-assisted suction clears T-zone buildup while staying gentler on cheeks.

steps.settings_note: Manual extraction only; no device preset.
steps.duration_rationale: Limited to visible non-inflamed comedones in central face and inner cheeks.
steps.how_to_do: Extract only open and closed comedones on nose, inner cheeks, forehead and chin after softening; skip papules, pustules, red inflamed bumps and broken skin; stop if swelling or pinpoint bleeding rises.
steps.script: Selective comedone clearing for cleaner pores and fewer bumps.

steps.settings_note: Approved HF acne-support preset not supplied; clinician to load approved post-extraction mode.
steps.duration_rationale: Minimum effective post-extraction sanitation on treated sites only.
steps.how_to_do: Glide high frequency briefly over extracted areas only; avoid prolonged heat build-up, and stop if sting or unexpected redness rises.
steps.script: Brief acne support over extracted areas to calm bacteria load.

steps.settings_note: Use approved carbon film protocol; full dry-down completed before laser.
steps.how_to_do: Apply an even carbon layer over forehead, nose, cheeks, chin and perioral skin, keeping clear of under-eyes, lips and active open lesions; use a thinner film on the hotter left cheek and allow the full dry period.
steps.script: Carbon film preps congested pores and mottled areas for laser clearing.

steps.order_reason: Main corrective once film is dry.
steps.settings_note: Approved local Carbon Facial laser preset not supplied; clinician must load the approved conservative acne-pore-pigment protocol before treatment.
steps.duration_rationale: Fixed Carbon laser dose per clinic timing rule.
steps.how_to_do: Use the approved conservative Carbon Facial laser protocol once the film is dry; prioritize nose, inner cheeks and forehead, give lighter work on the hotter left cheek, and avoid direct firing over active papules/pustules, under-eyes and lips; stop for excessive erythema or unexpected sting.
steps.script: Laser lifts pore debris, calms oil-acne congestion and brightens surface marks.

steps.settings_note: Ice Probe cooling with extra dwell on the hotter left cheek.
steps.duration_rationale: Extended to four minutes for post-energy recovery and left-cheek heat asymmetry.
steps.how_to_do: Immediately cool the treated face with the Ice Probe, keeping movement continuous and giving extra time to the left cheek and central face until heat settles.
steps.script: Cooling settles heat and reduces post-laser redness.

steps.settings_note: Lesion-only spot protocol; no extra cooling required after this step.
steps.how_to_do: Apply 20% Salicylic Acid Peel with a cotton tip only to visible active lesions on the forehead, cheeks and chin; avoid under-eye skin, lips, broken skin and freshly extracted openings; remove per product protocol if undue frosting or irritation appears.
steps.script: Targeted salicylic only on active spots to dry bumps faster.

steps.order_reason: Calms after laser and spot treatment.
steps.settings_note: Approved red LED recovery preset not supplied; clinician to load approved calming mode.
steps.duration_rationale: Minimum full recovery cycle after Carbon and lesion spot work.
steps.how_to_do: Run red LED over the full face after cooling and spot treatment to reduce reactive redness and support recovery; pause if warmth accumulates.
steps.script: Red light helps settle redness and supports healing.

steps.settings_note: Use approved gentle face-and-neck lymphatic technique; avoid direct pressure on active lesions.
steps.duration_rationale: Minimum-plus dose for mandatory drainage with mild puffiness present.
steps.how_to_do: Perform gentle face-and-neck lymphatic drainage using approved pathways; keep pressure feather-light over lesion-bearing cheeks and chin, and reduce pressure further on the hotter left cheek.
steps.script: Gentle drainage reduces puffiness without pressing on breakouts.

steps.settings_note: Ocular Ultrasound Infusion Probe protocol not supplied; clinician confirmation required before treatment.
steps.how_to_do: Using the Ocular Ultrasound Infusion Probe, infuse TRX A lightly along the under-eye crescent and orbital rim only; avoid lash line and lids, and stop if sting occurs.
steps.script: Focused under-eye infusion for darkness and comfort.

steps.order_reason: Post-laser pigment support on clear skin.
steps.settings_note: Face Ultrasound Infusion Probe protocol not supplied; clinician confirmation required before use.
steps.how_to_do: Use the face ultrasound infusion probe with TRX A over pigmented forehead and cheeks first, then a light pass over nose and chin; avoid direct infusion on active lesions, under-eyes and lips.
steps.script: Tranexamic infusion supports post-acne marks and uneven tone.

steps.how_to_do: Apply the calming peel-off mask evenly over the face, keeping clear of nostril openings, brow hair, under-eye margin and any lesion crusting; remove gently after full set.
steps.script: Calming mask cools skin after correction.

steps.settings_note: Combined serum, moisturiser and mineral sunscreen finish.
steps.how_to_do: Apply derma decode Brightening Serum Concentrate for Acne Marks and Pigmentation, then derma decode Oil Control Moisturizer for Oily Acne Prone Skin, then YUDERMA Eclipse Solaire Active Sunscreen SPF 50 PA+++ evenly over face and neck as the final protective layer.
steps.script: Serum, moisturiser and sunscreen finish the session and protect results.
additional_products: derma decode Brightening Serum Concentrate for Acne Marks and Pigmentation
derma decode Oil Control Moisturizer for Oily Acne Prone Skin
YUDERMA Eclipse Solaire Active Sunscreen SPF 50 PA+++

relevant_alternatives.reason: Useful for acne plus PIH, but Carbon gives stronger same-session pore clearing with broad pigment help and less full-face acid burden.
Strong for congestion, but it would do less than Carbon for concurrent cheek-forehead pigmentation and visible pore refinement.
Not chosen because today’s pigment is mild superficial post-acne marking and Carbon better also treats acne and pores in one session.

mother_case_reference.scope: Pointers to the complete maps in the stable mother reference for all supplied concerns, including secondary concerns. No patient findings are encoded in these pointers. Select relevant contenders once; do not assess every row.

planning_contract.evidence_contract: treatment-evidence-v1: canonical raw safety proxies and their source paths are in clinic_treatment_context.clinical_clearance. Supplied feature proxies fill missing diagnosis backend_details. No displayed score, normalized burden or feature diagnosis score substitutes for a raw measurement. Selected primary names remain exactly those in required_primary_concerns.
planning_contract.primary_strategy_rule: Exactly one strategy per required primary in every detailed session. Copy its exact concern name into the strategy and selected step target_concerns. A corrective Carbon strategy selects ENERGY.CARBON.LASER; never its PREP application or PEEL.SPOT.SALI. Do not invent aliases or findings.
planning_contract.spot_sali_product_rule: For PEEL.SPOT.SALI, choose exactly one approved named product from spot_sali_product_options and put it in additional_products. Do not select a default concentration or name the product only in prose.
planning_contract.spot_salicylic_cooling_rule: PEEL.SPOT.SALI does not require cooling after it or between it and Carbon/Q-switch, including a lip pass. Keep independently required immediate post-energy cooling and actual broad-peel-plus-Carbon preparation/cooling. The spot adjunct is not a broad/full-face peel.
